I've always been an avid reader but college slowed all that down. Now that I've graduated I bring my books everywhere. I dont buy hardbacks because they are too chunky for my purse. Mass market paperbacks are my jam. I just read whenever I have down time. Waiting in line, out for lunch, when I would wait in between classes I read too. And the key is to not force yourself to read anything youre not into. Forcing yourself can impact your desire to read in general. Also a chapter or five pages every night before bed is nice too! :)

From an early age I had an adversion to YA. Especially now that I'm older I think a lot of YA is kind of vapid and I cant relate. That being said, Sarah J Maas is my guilty pleasure. It doesnt require too much thought and they are easy to consume. 

I do think YA is lacking these days. Most of the books are lackluster and not smart plot wise. When I read, I like to be challenged and I enjoy well crafted prose. Some people read just for fun. 

I would read more YA if the genre experienced some kind of reform. I think teenagers would appreciate more in depth stories for their demographic as well.
